name: GM 3% target speed — fixed exploratory comparison
reason: Rules and code are hashed before the run, but this session cannot commit a preregistration. The archive has been used by earlier research. Results cannot be called an independent validation or automatically promote a live rule.
instrument: NSE stock futures, same actual expiry throughout each position
entry: Official next-session open, hypothetical paper execution; no signal-day fill
exit: First target or stop, including entry day; adverse open gaps fill at the open; ambiguous intrabar target/stop resolves to stop first; otherwise exit at session 20 or actual expiry
costMeaning: Assumed round-trip price percentage including execution friction, NOT verified GM fees. Gross price returns and both cost scenarios are reported separately.
controls: One active trade per member and symbol; all eligible symbols; no overlapping trades for that member/symbol; missing sessions censor a trade; no synthetic chart fill prices; no selection of a favourable holding period after outcomes
speedMeasures: Unconditional target fractions by session 1, 2, 5, 10 and 20; denominator includes failed and censored attempts. Median time to target is conditional and labelled separately.
statistics: Monthly means of net trade returns, Newey-West lag 3; Holm adjustment over every declared family and side; full skew/kurtosis Deflated Sharpe with at least 317 historical trials plus the declared comparisons. These are exploratory diagnostics, not proof of alpha or a portfolio return.
limitations: Daily bars cannot establish precise intrabar fill times or spreads
Historical tick masters are absent; target thresholds are mathematical price returns, not exact executable order prices
No contemporaneous intraday benchmark for target-time exits; no alpha claim
Recorded order books are unavailable locally and private release access returned 404; OI is not order-flow imbalance
No current recommendation without a fresh quote and a separately verified execution plan
